lastCompletedMilestone.title: universal DockyardOS control center and README rebuild

checkpointValidationEvidence.detail: The first docs-checkpoint CI attempt exposed nondeterminism in the ad-token tamper test because mutating the final Base64URL character can preserve decoded bytes through unused trailing bits. An exact rerun passed, confirming nondeterminism. The test was then repaired to mutate the first significant signature character so tampering always changes the decoded signature.

safetyInvariants: the Universal Control Center is a UI over existing Dockyard truth/policy boundaries, not a second authority
Auto Initialize requires workspace trust; automatic workspace initialization remains explicit opt-in
interactive Auto Initialize confirms host integration changes before applying them
dashboard actions and setting keys are extension-side allowlisted and webview input cannot inject arbitrary commands or settings
Dockyard Core child processes use shell=false
the fixed graffiti background is repository-owned and packaged locally rather than remotely fetched
Connections remains non-secret-bearing: credentials and tokens are not copied into project/checkpoint state
configured or installed MCP metadata is not treated as verified current-session connectivity
provider/MCP readiness never grants external mutation approval
Community Hub retains quarantine, signature, immutable-revision/hash and approval boundaries
Creative UI reference use remains original synthesis rather than reference-site cloning

nextMilestone.title: stable official-public v0.1.0 and first guarded live VS Code Marketplace publication
goals: deploy or identify the real operational DockyardOS public control-plane HTTPS origin
configure DOCKYARD_PUBLIC_CONTROL_URL without inventing or hardcoding a placeholder
perform read-only release preflight against the exact version and intended publication commit
verify Marketplace publisher setup and repository VSCE_PAT availability without exposing token material
require the exact v<extension version> tag to point at the intended stable publication commit
require explicit production publication approval before dispatching publish_marketplace=true
preserve workflow, GitHub release, asset digest and Marketplace listing evidence after a successful stable publication
externalGates: a real operational DockyardOS public control-plane HTTPS origin must be deployed and DOCKYARD_PUBLIC_CONTROL_URL configured
Marketplace publisher cassielxyz must exist and be authorized
repository Actions secret VSCE_PAT must be configured and valid for that publisher
the exact release tag must point at the intended publication commit
explicit production publication approval is required before live Marketplace mutation

resumeRules: inspect main, branches, pull requests, roadmap, checkpoint and CI before continuing
treat verifiedCodeSha as the completed code-state anchor; checkpoint-only documentation/test-reliability commits after it do not make the production checkpoint stale
if newer production code milestones exist, they override this checkpoint and the checkpoint must be repaired before continuing
do not replay P0-P38 unless regression evidence requires it
preserve the universal dashboard, Auto Initialize safety gates, shared UI design system and VSIX package assertions
keep runner-allocation failures, workflow-definition failures, flaky-test failures, external-provider failures and real code/test failures distinct

do not treat Preview 1 as stable P39 completion; do not perform the stable official-public/Marketplace mutation without the real control-plane origin, all external gates and explicit production approval
update this checkpoint immediately after the next completed production milestone

stableAttempt.detail: Release identity and full Core tests passed, then official-public stamping failed closed because DOCKYARD_PUBLIC_CONTROL_URL is not configured. No v0.1.0 tag or stable release was created.
